name: Sea
description: The Tethyan water breathes in slow teal bands. A ferry would be needed to cross safely.

name: Coast
description: Sand, shells, and salt grass mark the meeting place of land and old sea.

name: Plains
description: Open grassland rolls ahead, warm and easy on tired feet.

name: Forest
description: Rounded canopies gather into green shade, full of birdsong and hidden paths.

name: Wetland
description: Reeds and shallow pools shine with patient life.

name: Hills
description: Ochre hills rise and fall like sleeping cattle beneath the sun.

name: Mountains
description: Lavender-gray peaks hold the horizon and turn every step into a vista.

name: High Snow
description: Wind-packed snow above the treeline, quiet enough to hear your own steps break it.

name: Desert
description: Gold dust, low stones, and long quiet make this a place for careful travel.

name: River
description: A bright river line braids the land together and makes the air feel cooler.

name: Settlement
description: A welcoming cluster of clay roofs, flags, and evening cook-smoke offers rest.

name: Landmark
description: A memorable place waits here, asking to be named in your travel journal.

name: Lava Field
description: Cooled basalt in broken plates, warm underfoot, with a dull glow deep in the cracks.

name: Sky Island
description: A shelf of pale rock adrift in open air, grass clinging to its rim.

name: Sky Underside
description: The raw underside of a floating shelf, root-hung and hollow, with nothing below it.

name: Open Sky
description: Nothing but air and the long light between islands.

name: Underworld
description: Worked stone under a low roof, cold, and older than anything above it.
